content: The memory mapping header files shall provide a mech- anism to select different code, variable or constant sections by checking the defini- tion of the module specific Memory Allocation Key Words for starting a section (see [SWS_MemMap_00038]). Code, variables or constants declared after this selection shall be mapped to this section.
